column1: # Held-out questions for the facts in data/facts_survival_more.tsv (checked together
# with data/eval.tsv; a question listed here replaces the same question there).

how hard do i push for cpr on a toddler
column2: About 2 inches (5 cm), 1 or 2 hands.

column1: my baby is choking what do i do
column2: 5 back blows, then 5 chest thrusts.

column1: whats the frequency for marine emergencies
column2: VHF channel 16 (156.8 MHz).

column1: which cb channel is for emergencies
column2: Channel 9.

column1: what should i do if a pan catches fire
column2: Cover with a lid, turn off heat; never water.

column1: how do you use an extinguisher
column2: PASS: pull, aim low, squeeze, sweep.

column1: can i eat dandelion leaves
column2: Yes: leaves, flowers and roots.

column1: are toads edible
column2: No. Many toads are poisonous.

column1: how long is canned food good for
column2: High-acid 12-18 months, low-acid 2-5 years.

column1: what should i do if a nuclear bomb goes off
column2: Get inside, stay inside, stay tuned.

column1: how long do i stay inside after a nuclear explosion
column2: At least 24 hours, unless told otherwise.

column1: someone is having a seizure what do i do
column2: Cushion head, time it, nothing in their mouth.

column1: how long is too long for a seizure
column2: If it lasts over 5 minutes, or repeats.

column1: what are signs of a severe allergy
column2: Swelling, hives, trouble breathing, faintness.

column1: where do you inject an epi pen
column2: Outer thigh, through clothes; hold 3 seconds.

column1: what do i do if my friend fell through the ice
column2: Reach or throw, don't go out; call for help.

column1: how do i save a drowning person
column2: Reach or throw, don't go: use a pole or rope.

column1: should i pull out something stuck in a wound
column2: No. Pad around it and get help.

column1: my blood sugar is low
column2: If awake: 15 g fast sugar; recheck in 15 min.

column1: how do i treat a bad sunburn
column2: Cool showers, aloe, fluids; stay out of sun.

column1: what do i do if i get chemicals in my eyes
column2: Flush with clean water for 20 minutes.

column1: is ice good for burns
column2: No. Use cool running water, not ice.

column1: how do i keep my matches from getting wet
column2: Waterproof case, or dip the heads in wax.

column1: what is the difference between a tornado watch and a warning
column2: Watch: possible. Warning: happening, take cover.

column1: what does it mean when there is a ring around the moon
column2: Often rain or snow within a day or two.

column1: how do i shut off my gas
column2: Quarter turn so the valve crosses the pipe.

column1: what to do if im stuck under a collapsed building
column2: Cover your mouth, tap on pipes, shout last.

column1: how much water do i need per hour hiking
column2: About half a liter per hour; more in heat.

column1: how do i tell how much daylight is left
column2: Each finger from sun to horizon is ~15 min.

column1: does my phone compass work offline
column2: Yes. The compass works offline.

column1: how do i do cpr on a dog
column2: I don't know.

column1: how do i treat a snake bite on a dog
column2: I don't know.

column1: what is the police radio frequency
column2: I don't know.

column1: how do i hotwire a car
column2: I don't know.

column1: can you eat poison ivy
column2: I don't know.

column1: how do i survive a volcano eruption
column2: Evacuate if told; avoid ash, wear an N95.
